title: Multiplexed Array for Rapid Assessment of Spliced and Unspliced XBP1
author: Creedican, Talty, et al.
materials: MCF10A (ATCC) cells were maintained in DMEM/F-12 (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA) supplemented with 5% horse serum (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA), 20 ng/mL epidermal growth factor (PeproTech, London, UK), 0.5 μg/mL hydrocortisone (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA), 100 ng/mL cholera toxin (Sigma- Aldrich, St. Louis, USA), 10 μg/mL insulin (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA), 50 U/mL penicillin, and 50 μg/mL streptomycin (St. Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA). MCF7 cells (ECACC) were cultured in DMEM high glucose (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA) supplemented with 10% foetal bovine serum (FBS), 0.01 mg/mL insulin (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA), and 2 mM L-glutamine. MDA-MB-231 cells were cultured in DMEM high glucose (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA) supplemented with 10% FBS, 50 U/mL penicillin, 50 μg/mL streptomycin, and 2 mM L-glutamine. U937 and THP-1 (ATCC, Manassas, USA) cells were cultured in RPMI-1640 medium (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA) supplemented with 10% FBS (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA), 50 U/mL penicillin, 50 μg/ml streptomycin (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA), and 2 mM L-glutamine (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA). All cells were cultured at 37 °C, 5% CO2 in a humidified incubator and adherent cells seeded at an appropriate density 24 h prior to treatment. U937 cells were seeded at 5X105 cells/mL and treated immediately while THP-1 cells were seeded at 1X106 cells/mL and treated after 2 h.

Cells were washed once in ice cold phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) and then lysed in either RIPA buffer (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA) with RocheSTOP® protease inhibitors (Roche, Basel, Switzerland) for protein analysis or directly lysed in TriReagent (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA) as per manufacturer’s instructions for RNA analysis.

steps.title: Prepare cell culture media
steps.instruction:
Prepare the following media formulations:
- MCF10A: DMEM/F‑12 supplemented with 5 % horse serum, 20 ng/mL EGF, 0.5 µg/mL hydrocortisone, 100 ng/mL cholera toxin, 10 µg/mL insulin, 50 U/mL penicillin, 50 µg/mL streptomycin.
- MCF7: DMEM high glucose supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum, 0.01 mg/mL insulin, 2 mM L‑glutamine.
- MDA‑MB‑231: DMEM high glucose supplemented with 10 % FBS, 50 U/mL penicillin, 50 µg/mL streptomycin, 2 mM L‑glutamine.
- U937 and THP‑1: RPMI‑1640 supplemented with 10 % FBS, 50 U/mL penicillin, 50 µg/mL streptomycin, 2 mM L‑glutamine.
All reagents are from the catalogues indicated in the source text. Store media at 4 °C until use.

steps.title: Seed cells at appropriate density
steps.instruction:
Seed cells in a humidified incubator at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂:
- Adherent lines (MCF10A, MCF7, MDA‑MB‑231): seed at a density that reaches ~70 % confluence after 24 h (exact density per plate size as required) and allow 24 h before any treatment.
- Suspension lines: seed U937 at 5 × 10⁵ cells/mL and treat immediately; seed THP‑1 at 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL and treat after a 2 h incubation.

steps.title: Apply experimental treatments
steps.instruction: Treat the cultured cells with the experimental agents or conditions required for the study. (Specific treatment details are not provided in the source text and should follow the experimental design.)

steps.title: Wash cells with ice‑cold PBS
steps.instruction: Remove culture medium, then wash the cells once with ice‑cold phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS).

steps.title: Lyse cells for downstream analysis
steps.instruction:
Lyse cells according to the intended downstream assay:
- For protein analysis: add RIPA buffer (Sigma‑Aldrich) containing RocheSTOP® protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche) and incubate on ice as per standard protocol.
- For RNA analysis: add TriReagent (Sigma‑Aldrich) directly to the cells and process according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Statistical analysis of results
steps.instruction: Analyze quantitative data using a two‑tailed t‑test with Welch’s correction or one‑way ANOVA, as appropriate. Consider p < 0.05 statistically significant. Perform all calculations and final analysis in R version 3.5.1 “Feather Spray”.
